snippet.title: Backrooms Anomaly Project Demo Gameplay Trailer #1 | Mahatsu
snippet.description:
Wishlist Backrooms Anomaly Project on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4725940?utm_source=Youtube

Play the free demo and step into the unsettling world of the Backrooms. Explore eerie yellow corridors, watch for anomalies, and decide whether to move forward or turn back. One small detail could change everything. 👁️

Features:
- Anomaly-spotting horror gameplay
- Atmospheric Backrooms environments
- Creepy visuals and unsettling sounds
- A mysterious world hiding things in plain sight
- Every detail matters. Stay alert.

🔗 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4725940?utm_source=Youtube

#BackroomsAnomalyProject #BackroomsGame #PsychologicalHorror #IndieHorror #HorrorGames
